additional_info.subject: [Urgent] Sicharge (S/N) sruJwD - Stopped Charging Right After Initiated
additional_info.body:
Dear Siemens Support Centre,
Please find the PROBLEM as described below, refer to the attached VIDEO taken by CPO on site. Can you please check what was GOING WRONG with the charging sessions on 21-July-2024 at Malaysia Time (GMT+8) – 13:14 to 13:16, and 13:40 to 13:42.
Product: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset: MP / ND 170000121
ChargerID/Serial No.: sruJwD
Problem Description: Charging stopped after 5 seconds after successful initiation, deemed as “completed charging” but actual fact is NOT.
Kindly help to response in the soonest meantime as the CC2 (liquid-cooled cable nozzle) is unable to function and CPO is having revenue losses as there were 10 electric vehicles passed thru since the incident reported.
Regards,
Steven
